local function VJXGXN_fake_script() -- TextButton.Script 
	local script = Instance.new('Script', TextButton)

	local skyboxIds = {
		"rbxassetid://13615351249",
		"rbxassetid://8925805033"
	}
	
	local textButton1 = script.Parent
	
	local function changeSkybox()
		local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	
		while true do
			for _, skyboxId in ipairs(skyboxIds) do
				local skybox = Instance.new("Sky")
	
				skybox.SkyboxBk = skyboxId
				skybox.SkyboxDn = skyboxId
				skybox.SkyboxFt = skyboxId
				skybox.SkyboxLf = skyboxId
				skybox.SkyboxRt = skyboxId
				skybox.SkyboxUp = skyboxId
	
				for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Sky") then
						child:Destroy()
					end
				end
	
				skybox.Parent = Lighting
				wait(0.2)
			end
		end
	end
	
	local isRunning = false
	
	textButton1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if not isRunning then
			isRunning = true
			spawn(changeSkybox) 
		end
	end)
	
	-- Edited By PilinTeam And Ivanna_Banana
	-- Join Now The PilinTeam discord.gg/KJeEB3npRb
end

local function IVXCS_fake_script() -- TextButton_5.Script 
	local script = Instance.new('Script', TextButton_5)

	
	local function RemoveScripts(object)
		for _, descendant in pairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
				descendant:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
	
	
	local function ChangeAllTextAndColor()
		local triggerButton = script.Parent 
		local triggerGui = triggerButton:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui") 
	
		
		local excludedGui = triggerGui
	
		for _, object in pairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
			if (object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextLabel")) then
				local objectGui = object:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
				local isButtonOnExcludedGui = (objectGui == excludedGui)
	
				if not isButtonOnExcludedGui then
					
					RemoveScripts(object)
	
					
					spawn(function()
						
						local function RainbowTextAndColor()
							local hue = 0
							local saturation = 1
							local value = 1
							local rainbowSpeed = 90
							local baseTextSize = object.TextSize 
							while true do
								local rainbowColor = Color3.fromHSV(hue, saturation, value)
								object.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
								object.BackgroundColor3 = rainbowColor
								object.Text = "Virus Potato"
								hue = (hue + (1/rainbowSpeed)) % 1 
	
								wait(0.03) 
							end
						end
	
						RainbowTextAndColor()
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	
	local triggerButton = script.Parent 
	
	triggerButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ChangeAllTextAndColor()
	end)
	
	-- Edited By PilinTeam And Ivanna_Banana
	-- Join Now The PilinTeam discord.gg/KJeEB3npRb
end

					createParticleEmitter(v, t2)

				end

							createParticleEmitter(part, t2)
							createParticleEmitter(part, t3)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

	local numberOfChanges = 10000000000000000000000 -- Number of times to change color
	local delayBetweenChanges = 0.2
	
	
	local function changeAvatarColorMultipleTimes()
		for i = 1, numberOfChanges do
			for _, player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if player.Character then
					for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
						if part:IsA("MeshPart") or part:IsA("Part") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
							part.BrickColor = BrickColor.Random()

	end

		end

		spawn(function() 
			while wait(0.1) do

local function IPOOHI_fake_script() -- Frame.Drag 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Frame)

	local UIS = game:GetService('UserInputService')
	
	local frame = script.Parent
	
	
	
	local dragToggle = nil
	
	local dragSpeed = 0.25
	
	local dragStart = nil
	
	local startPos = nil
	
	
	
	local function updateInput(input)
	
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
	
		local position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
	
			startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	
		game:GetService('TweenService'):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(dragSpeed), {Position = position}):Play()
	
	end
	
	
	
	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then 
	
			dragToggle = true
	
			dragStart = input.Position
	
			startPos = frame.Position
	
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
	
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
	
					dragToggle = false
	
				end
	
			end)
	
		end
	
	end)
	
	
	
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
	
			if dragToggle then
	
				updateInput(input)
	
			end
	
		end
	
	end)
end
coroutine.wrap(IPOOHI_fake_script)()
